body: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking's retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8 × and index vector count by 22.4 ×. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality-fidelity-cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.
summaryZh: PRIME 框架针对 LLM Agent 的外部知识库检索进行了索引侧优化。通过语义重构（SR）将长文档转化为结构化信息，并结合元数据合成（MS）与分层检索（HR），在保持检索质量的前提下，将嵌入计算量降低了 45.8 倍，索引向量数量减少了 22.4 倍。该研究证明了索引侧的结构化处理是提升 RAG 系统效率与效果的关键杠杆，为构建高效的 Agent 知识检索系统提供了新思路。

aiReview.reasonZh: PRIME框架通过优化索引侧结构化处理，在提升检索质量的同时大幅降低了计算成本，对Agent系统的知识库构建具有实用价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 检索增强生成，通过外部知识库辅助模型生成。
语义重构，将非结构化文档转化为结构化信息。
分层检索，通过多级索引实现从粗到细的检索。
嵌入，将文本转化为向量表示。
衡量问答准确性的指标。
